name: event_id
description: Unique event id; the idempotency key.

name: quantity
description: STOCK_UPDATED: resulting stock. SALE: units sold. RESTOCK: units added.

name: previous_quantity
description: Stock before the change, when the source reports it.

name: occurred_at
description: When the change happened in the store. Partition column.

name: metadata
description: Free-form attributes sent by the client.

name: processing_status
description: PROCESSED once the processor stored the event.
